name: 78226 · San Antonio, TX
findings: ZIP 78226 (San Antonio) has 15 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (67%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78226 (San Antonio) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 78226 (San Antonio) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
